name: B10-0188/2024 (Verts/ALE) – The increasing and systematic repression of women in Iran
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the increasing and systematic repression of women in Iran
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and asking for action. It condemns Iran's treatment of women who resist compulsory hijab rules, including forced psychiatric detention. It asks Iran to release detained women's rights defenders, drop discriminatory laws and allow United Nations investigators in. It asks the European Union to give more money and emergency visas to Iranian women's rights defenders, and to consider sanctions and legal cases against Iranian officials.

- Nothing changes yet; Parliament only states demands and opinions.
- Affects Iranian women and rights defenders, and European Union governments.
- Next: European Union governments and officials decide whether to act.
